title: Research Attention
population: Hugging Face Daily Papers recommendations, deduplicated by paper ID within each platform week
formula: round_half_up(100 × current topic share / previous topic share)
eligibility: At least five topic papers in each week, nonzero previous share and comparable collection. Stable: 95–105; rising: above 105; falling: below 95. Otherwise Watching.
classifier_field: paper title, case-insensitive; unchanged frozen attention-index-v1 rules
baseline_note: Both historical lists were retrieved on October 19 with the same API pagination and classifier. The October 5–11 comparison contains 361 recommendations; the earlier published report retains its original 349-record snapshot. This is a fresh retrospective comparison, not an edit to that report.
limits: Recommendations measure attention within this platform sample, not all publications, quality, adoption or hiring. Topics overlap. Two weeks establish one comparison, not a sustained trend. Paper publication dates are separate from recommendation dates. Records are metadata, not full-text scientific reviews.
